name: Banana
selection: Buy to match when you will eat them, not what looks best. Green-tipped fruit is three or four days off, solid yellow is ready, and brown speckles mean the starch has turned to sugar — when most people prefer eating and the only ones worth baking with.
storage: Counter, never the refrigerator: cold blackens the peel within hours and stops the ripening for good. Splitting the bunch and separating the stems slows things down a little.
